title: Step 13 — the initiator checks that the mirror leg exists before revealing anything
description: counterparty_locked is the gate that makes the swap safe: until the relay has observed the responder's lock on spoke-pen, the initiator must not settle, and the gateway refuses to.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, reading its own leg (mock-pvp-hp-11). BLOCKING DIVERGENCE, verified in the delivered gateway (GetHTLCStatus returns c.JSON(result)): the body is the bare lock record, NOT wrapped in a lock key as the platform OpenAPI document and contracts/pvp declare. The delivered record also carries counterparty_locked, amount and created_at, which the contract does not declare, and carries no secret field, which the contract does. state uses the prefixed vocabulary (HTLC_STATE_LOCKED) while the state query parameter of /api/v1/htlc/search takes the bare form (LOCKED) — the platform never reconciles the two. Attempting to settle with counterparty_locked false yields 500 with 'counterparty spoke has not yet locked its leg'.
